recognize_zh: 箭頭處可見一個由約 16–20 個紫色小核（merozoite）組成的團塊，中央有棕色瘧色素聚集，為成熟裂殖體（schizont）；裂殖子數目多於 12 個，支持間日瘧（P. vivax），且宿主紅血球輪廓已不清楚。
features: Mature schizont composed of numerous (approximately 16-20) discrete merozoites with magenta chromatin
Centrally aggregated golden-brown hemozoin pigment within the merozoite cluster
Host red cell membrane poorly defined, suggesting a rupturing or segmented schizont
Surrounding red cells are uninfected and show mild anisocytosis with central pallor
Merozoites are irregularly arranged rather than forming a neat rosette
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature malarial schizont containing approximately 16-20 merozoites arranged irregularly around a central clump of golden-brown hemozoin pigment. The outline of the host red cell is indistinct, consistent with a segmenting schizont near rupture. The remaining red cells are uninfected. The number of merozoites and the presence of schizonts in peripheral blood favor Plasmodium vivax; findings are consistent with P. vivax schizont.

ddx.vs: P. malariae schizonts contain fewer merozoites (6-12) arranged in a regular rosette around central pigment within a normal-sized or small red cell.
P. ovale schizonts contain 6-14 merozoites within an oval, fimbriated red cell with James dots.
P. falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood, and their presence usually accompanies heavy parasitemia with many small rings and crescent gametocytes.
Platelet aggregates contain purple granules within pale cytoplasm but lack discrete nuclear chromatin dots and hemozoin pigment.
